Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Geb wrote:
>
> hello all
>
> the burning an ally or retainer is a cost?

No. The cost of a card is only the number listed drop on the side.

> can one player put in play
> one war ghoul burning no minion if he didn't have any?

No, since he'll always have at least one once he puts the War Ghoul
into play - the War Ghoul herself. So he'd have to burn the War Ghoul
if he doesn't burn a different ally or retainer.
